comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Each entry shows a name sign as the car enters the trigger radius. lat/lon are real OSM coordinates projected into world space. radius in compressed-world meters. 'needs_owner_review': true flags entries the owner should verify with lived knowledge — map data may be imprecise for community boundaries. Ordered roughly along the route.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The Palisadoes spit — sea on both sides heading into Kingston

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout into Windward Road; potholes begin here

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: East Kingston industrial and residential area

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Mountain View Avenue — National Stadium nearby

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Business and hotel district; Trafalgar Road / Hope Road corridor

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Major commercial hub; the clock tower is iconic

communities.name: Constant Spring
communities.note: Constant Spring Road; Usain Bolt's Tracks & Records is here

communities.name: Portmore
communities.note: Large dormitory city west of Kingston; route passes near its approaches

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former colonial capital; route passes via Spanish Town Bypass

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Entry to the gorge; Flat Bridge is ahead

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town; 'Linstead Market' in the folk song

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hill-country junction; goat country begins here

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Bamboo
communities.note: The bamboo avenue stretch leading into Fern Gully

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Lush canopied ravine road — ancient fern species line the walls

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: End of the run — Dunn's River Falls awaits
